title: Act-HiMotif: Hierarchical Daily Activity Schedule Generation via Learned Activity-Structure Motifs
abstract: arXiv:2611.06038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating daily activity schedules from individual attributes (e.g., age and income) is valuable for activity-based travel modeling and human behavior simulation. The task is challenging because exact activity structures follow a highly imbalanced, long-tailed distribution, while the same structure can admit multiple duration allocations under a fixed full-day budget. Direct generation must therefore learn many exact activity structures from highly uneven observations while modeling their possible temporal realizations. However, many exact structures share recurring activity organization. Based on this observation, we propose Act-HiMotif, a hierarchical motif-based generative model that introduces learned, reusable activity-structure motifs as an intermediate representation between individual profiles and specific activity structures. translated_title: Act-HiMotif：通过学习的活动结构主题进行层次化日程活动计划生成
translated_abstract: 从个体属性（如年龄和收入）生成日程活动计划，对于基于活动的出行建模和人类行为模拟具有重要价值。这项任务具有挑战性，因为精确的活动结构遵循高度不平衡的长尾分布，而同一结构在固定的全天时间预算下又可以有多种时长分配方式。因此，直接生成方法必须从高度不均匀的观测数据中学习大量精确的活动结构，同时建模其可能的时间实现方式。然而，许多精确结构实际上共享重复出现的活动组织模式。基于这一观察，我们提出了Act-HiMotif，这是一种基于主题（motif）的层次化生成模型，它引入了通过学习获得的、可复用的活动结构主题，作为个体画像与特定活动结构之间的中间表示。Act-HiMotif首先区分仅有居家活动的日子和有外出活动的日子，然后从以个体画像为条件的主题分布中采样一个主题……
tldr: 该论文提出Act-HiMotif，一种层次化生成模型，通过学习可复用的活动结构主题作为个体画像与活动结构之间的中间表示，从个体属性生成每日活动计划，有效应对活动结构长尾分布和同一结构下多种时长分配的挑战。
en_tdlr: Act-HiMotif is a hierarchical generative model that introduces learned, reusable activity-structure motifs as an intermediate representation between individual profiles and specific activity structures, enabling daily schedule generation that handles the long-tailed distribution of activity structures and their multiple duration allocations.
